name: Mobility Database
description: Authoritative global catalog of GTFS schedule, GTFS-Realtime, and GBFS feeds (~6,000) with daily-mirrored snapshots and stable mdb-* IDs, operated by MobilityData (the GTFS/GBFS spec stewards).

dataSources.purpose: Discover and download GTFS schedule feeds for import into the local GTFS catalog. Per-feed license metadata flows into the import pipeline.
dataSources.dataReceived: Provider name, country, mdb-* id, producer URL, latest snapshot URL + hash, license URL
